description: Implementation of FramePartsCollectorListener class for handling HTTP/2 frame events in test environment.

classes.name: FramePartsCollectorListener
classes.description: A test utility class for collecting and handling HTTP/2 frame parts during testing.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Handles the reception of a frame header, logs and expects the header.

methods.name: OnDataStart
methods.description: Handles the start of data frame, logs and initiates data frame processing.

methods.name: OnDataPayload
methods.description: Handles data payload, logs and forwards data to current frame.

methods.name: OnDataEnd
methods.description: Handles end of data frame, logs and finalizes data frame processing.

methods.name: OnHeadersStart
methods.description: Handles start of headers frame, logs and initiates headers frame processing.

methods.name: OnHeadersPriority
methods.description: Handles headers priority, logs and updates current frame.

methods.name: OnHpackFragment
methods.description: Handles HPACK fragment data, logs and forwards to current frame.

methods.name: OnHeadersEnd
methods.description: Handles end of headers, logs and finalizes headers frame.

methods.name: OnPriorityFrame
methods.description: Handles priority frame, logs and processes priority.

methods.name: OnContinuationStart
methods.description: Handles start of continuation frame, logs and initiates continuation.

methods.name: OnContinuationEnd
methods.description: Handles end of continuation frame, logs and finalizes continuation.

methods.name: OnPadLength
methods.description: Handles padding length, logs and updates current frame.

methods.name: OnPadding
methods.description: Handles padding data, logs and forwards to current frame.

methods.name: OnRstStream
methods.description: Handles RST_STREAM frame, logs and processes error code.

methods.name: OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Handles start of SETTINGS frame, logs, checks frame type and flags, and initiates settings.

methods.name: OnSetting
methods.description: Handles individual setting fields, logs and updates current frame.

methods.name: OnSettingsEnd
methods.description: Handles end of SETTINGS frame, logs and finalizes settings.

methods.name: OnSettingsAck
methods.description: Handles SETTINGS acknowledgment, logs and processes acknowledgment.

methods.name: OnPushPromiseStart
methods.description: Handles start of PUSH_PROMISE frame, logs, checks frame type, and initiates push promise.

methods.name: OnPushPromiseEnd
methods.description: Handles end of PUSH_PROMISE frame, logs and finalizes push promise.

methods.name: OnPing
methods.description: Handles PING frame, logs and processes ping.

methods.name: OnPingAck
methods.description: Handles PING acknowledgment, logs and processes acknowledgment.

methods.name: OnGoAwayStart
methods.description: Handles start of GOAWAY frame, logs and initiates goaway processing.

methods.name: OnGoAwayOpaqueData
methods.description: Handles opaque data in GOAWAY frame, logs and forwards data.

methods.name: OnGoAwayEnd
methods.description: Handles end of GOAWAY frame, logs and finalizes goaway processing.

methods.name: OnWindowUpdate
methods.description: Handles WINDOW_UPDATE frame, logs and updates window size.

methods.name: OnAltSvcStart
methods.description: Handles start of ALTSVC frame, logs and initiates ALTSVC processing.

methods.name: OnAltSvcOriginData
methods.description: Handles ALTSVC origin data, logs and forwards data.

methods.name: OnAltSvcValueData
methods.description: Handles ALTSVC value data, logs and forwards data.

methods.name: OnAltSvcEnd
methods.description: Handles end of ALTSVC frame, logs and finalizes ALTSVC processing.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateStart
methods.description: Handles start of PRIORITY_UPDATE frame, logs and initiates update.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdatePayload
methods.description: Handles PRIORITY_UPDATE payload data, logs and forwards data.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateEnd
methods.description: Handles end of PRIORITY_UPDATE frame, logs and finalizes update.

methods.name: OnUnknownStart
methods.description: Handles start of unknown frame, logs and initiates processing.

methods.name: OnUnknownPayload
methods.description: Handles payload of unknown frame, logs and forwards data.

methods.name: OnUnknownEnd
methods.description: Handles end of unknown frame, logs and finalizes processing.

methods.name: OnPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Handles case where padding is too long, logs and processes error.

methods.name: OnFrameSizeError
methods.description: Handles frame size error, logs and processes error.
